desc: The Tokarev TSP-12 is an innovative 12GA pump-action shotgun built for versatility and fast handling. Featuring an 18.5" barrel, synthetic stock, optics-ready drilled and tapped receiver, fiber optic front sight, and 4+1 capacity, the TSP-12 stands apart with its unique stock-actuated pump system that cycles the action by pulling the buttstock or pistol grip rearward.
